title: Not appropriate for young readers-very mature audiences only
text:
While most of the comics were great, I was very disturbed that 3 of them were rated A for Adult, and one contained graphic naked sex scenes in them. Unfortunately, I gave the box to my 13 year old twin sons for Christmas before looking through them. I had no idea that pornography would be in the comics. I can’t believe that these comics are being sold to anyone. They should come with
a warning that there is nudity and extreme violence in some of them. Definitely not appropriate for young readers.
label: negative
